title: Scale-Down Vanish
description: Từng ký tự thu nhỏ về tâm của chính nó rồi biến mất, rất nhanh, nối đuôi từ trái sang.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-scale-down-vanish, written here): Split chars; left to right, each char scale 1 → 0 about its own centre, 0.25 s easeInQuad (CSS cubic-bezier(.55,.085,.68,.53), labelled power2.in), stagger 20 ms (demo 50 ms capped 0.5 s, 0.35 s each), from 0.9 s. Demo marks each vanish point with a small accent + cross that fades in. Loop: text fades back 2.4–2.9 s; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.25 s) · stagger (0.02 s) · ease (easeInQuad).
